_comment: 物品表。加新物品：照 glowing_wood 抄一条。rarity 取 common / uncommon / rare / epic / legendary；burn = 燃烧值；icon = 图（res:// 路径，背包里按整数倍放大）；personal = 私人物品（不能烧掉，比如照片、信）。文字中英两套。desc_fixed（可选）= 修好以后换的描述（音乐盒：剧本里 flag musicbox_fixed 之后用）。森林章节的私人物品 burn 先填 0，以后飞行段再给燃料值。desc_from_tag（可选）= 描述后面接上带这个 tag 的日记条目（大象的画）。added = 描述是补写的（不是剧情姐原文），给她审。第三版的任务物品（木板、罐子、松脂、弹簧、阀门、要送还的三件）personal=true、burn=0：不能烧。 category = material（燃料材料）/ keepsake（纪念品）/ quest（任务物品）。纪念品的 keepsake_burn = 以后飞行段烧掉它给的燃料（60~120），burn_note = 烧掉时晨的一句话（先空）；森林里不烧纪念品，所以 personal 和 burn 保持原样，燃料计算不变。 第六版（10-29 合订稿）：communicator = 通讯器（quest、personal、不能烧，背包里点开是聊天界面，联系人和记录见 data/phone.json）；日记里夹的回忆页不是独立物品，是日记里 tag=memory 的两条（合订稿里烧日记时只留下首页，回忆页跟着日记走）；fixed_part = 修好的推进器零件（弥洛包好、回飞机时装回去）。 11-02 第一关新版（docs/剧情改动/第一关新版_实现规格.md）：family_photo / deer_bear / rabbit_fur / floorboard（给两块，每块 50）/ miluo_letter 是新物品，描述一句话，keepsake_burn 按本2兔的燃烧值；图标 art/forest_story/icon_<id>.png（ch1-fx 画，没画好之前是色块）。glowing_wood 改名永燃之木（燃烧值 0，之后丢弃）。elephant_drawing 加 back（背面地图：after 那个 flag 以后描述接上背面）和 no_burn（永远不能烧）。fuel_kind（11-02 夜，支线）：unrelated = 无关燃料，飞行一先自动全烧，需要的量按持有的算 +100；personal = 私人物品（玩具熊、全家福），最后二选一；none = 不能烧。

desc.en: It glows but gives off no heat. Just the thing to bring when visiting a friend you're not that close to.
desc.zh: 发光，但不发热，很适合拿来探望关系一般的朋友。

items._note: 11-02 第一关新版：兔子舞步赢来的；弥洛放进炉子烧不起来（临时转折，等本2兔定稿），之后丢弃。燃烧值 0；关卡地上那块发光木头不再出现（story_forest hide_props）。

desc.en: The back used to say "Fly Safe." Now all that's left is "Safe."
desc.zh: 背面还印着「安全飞行」，现在只剩「飞行」两个字了。

desc.en: Smells a little sweet. People who've tasted it generally don't want to talk about it.
desc.zh: 闻着有点甜，尝过的人一般不愿意聊这件事。

desc.en: It breaks with a sharp crack. Good for taking out your anger if you don't dare slam a door.
desc.zh: 掰断时响得很脆，适合替不敢摔门的人发脾气。

desc.en: The elephant in the photo is a little blurry. Whoever took it probably didn't expect it to move.
desc.zh: 照片里的大象有点糊，拍照的人大概也没想到它会动。

desc.en: Whoever drew the map hesitated at the turns. They rubbed the paper thin with the eraser.
desc.zh: 画地图的人在拐弯处犹豫过，橡皮把纸都擦薄了。

items._note: 11-02 第一关新版：双面纸，正面大象、背面地图（paper_view 翻面；c1_got_map 以后描述里接上背面）。最重要的剧情道具，永远不能烧：category quest、no_burn，不进任何 keepsake_choice。

desc.en: "No results found." In smaller print below, "Thank you for your patience."
desc.zh: 「未找到」，下面还有一行小字：感谢您的耐心。

desc.en: The name is the most worn part. The card clocks out before its owner does.
desc.zh: 磨损最重的地方是名字，卡比本人更早下班。

desc.en: There are bread crumbs on the back. Even after all this time, I can't bring myself to brush them off.
desc.zh: 照片背面沾着面包屑，隔了这么久，还是舍不得抖掉。

desc.en: It always sticks in the same place. Listen long enough and the second half starts to sound wrong.
desc.zh: 总在同一个地方卡住，听久了会觉得后半首才是错的。

desc_fixed.en: It can finally sing the whole tune. The bottom still bears the marks from all those slaps.
desc_fixed.zh: 终于能唱完了，底下还留着挨过巴掌的印子。

desc.en: There's a hole where the creases meet. People there probably never need to ask for directions.
desc.zh: 折痕交会的地方破了个洞，那里的人应该不用问路。

desc.en: Put it in your mouth and the grown-ups will chase you. I tried it as a kid.
desc.zh: 放进嘴里就会被大人追着跑，小时候试过。

desc.en: The handwriting is neat for the first few pages. Then the swearing starts.
desc.zh: 前几页字迹工整，后面开始骂人。

desc.en: Thoroughly broken. Saves everyone the trouble of arguing over whether it still works.
desc.zh: 坏得很彻底，倒省了争论还能不能用。

desc.en: Wrapped in three layers of paper, as if it's afraid of going back to the repair shop.
desc.zh: 包了三层纸，像是很怕再回修理铺。

desc.en: It wheezes so hard when it runs that you feel bad asking it to hurry.
desc.zh: 工作时喘得厉害，听着都不好意思催它。

desc.en: Almost invisible in your palm. If you lose it, all you can do is pretend it's still there.
desc.zh: 放在掌心几乎看不见，丢了也只能假装还在。

desc.en: The last line is crammed into tiny letters. Whoever wrote it clearly didn't realize how much they had to say.
desc.zh: 最后一行挤得很小，写纸条的人显然低估了自己的话多。

desc.en: Whoever wrote "Everything's fine here" pressed so hard the pen went through the paper.
desc.zh: 「这里一切都好」写得很用力，笔尖戳破了纸。

desc.en: The nails are gone. The holes are still there. It can hold just as much weight.
desc.zh: 钉子拔掉了，洞还在，不影响继续承重。

desc.en: It's been washed several times. Get close and it still smells of the last batch of pickles.
desc.zh: 洗了好几遍，凑近闻还是上一份咸菜。

desc.en: The lid's sealed tight. For now, even the owner's locked out.
desc.zh: 盖子封得很严，暂时连主人也防着。

desc.en: Push it down and it springs right back. It's got more of a temper than you'd think.
desc.zh: 按下去还会弹回来，脾气比看起来大。

desc.en: Best to swear a little while you turn it. That's how the old hands do it.
desc.zh: 拧的时候最好骂两句，老师傅都是这么修的。

desc.en: It gets loud all of a sudden when you change stations. Like an older relative who gets switched off once they fall asleep.
desc.zh: 换台时会突然大声，像睡着以后被人关掉的长辈。

desc.en: Both sides say "Straight ahead." Proceed at your own risk.
desc.zh: 两面都写着「前方」，建议自行承担后果。

desc.en: The wick is neatly trimmed. For now, the lack of oil is someone else's problem.
desc.zh: 灯芯剪得很整齐，没油这件事暂时不归它管。

desc.en: Smooth to the touch. The former owner won't let you stroke it the wrong way.
desc.zh: 摸着很顺，原主人不许逆着摸。

desc.en: Hard to say if it sounds like a bird. It's already scared the birds away.
desc.zh: 吹得像不像鸟不知道，已经把鸟吹走了。

desc.en: Hold it long enough and it warms up. Let go and you have to start all over again.
desc.zh: 攥久了会热，松手以后又得重新来。

desc.en: Someone probably said "Quit fooling around" before the photo. One person didn't stop smiling in time.
desc.zh: 拍照前大概有人说了「别闹」，有个人还没来得及收住笑。

desc.en: The deer's name is stitched onto the tail. The stitches were taken out once, then the name was sewn back on.
desc.zh: 尾巴上缝着小鹿的名字，拆过一次，又缝回去了。
还黏着一点草，兔子生前似乎不太讲究。
desc.en: There's still a bit of grass stuck to it. The rabbit didn't seem too fussy about appearances when it was alive.
It creaks if you step on one spot. Leaving the house hasn't changed that.
desc.zh: 有一处踩上去会响，离开那间屋子以后也没改。

desc.en: Milo says to burn it. The person it was meant for wouldn't blush even if they read it.
desc.zh: 弥洛说烧吧，反正那个人看了也不会脸红。
